page_title: LIV 1-0 EVE | Liverpool v Everton 02/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Samuel Barrott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+7' What a great effort! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
90+5' Ashley Young (Everton) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

90+5' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.
90+3' The referee signals a substitution. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Mohamed Salah.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Armando Broja (Everton) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
88' That's a clear yellow card. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) goes into the book.
88' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
87' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
86' David Moyes prepares a substitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure is replaced by Chermiti (Everton).
86' Substitution. Luis Diaz will be replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
85' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.

83' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
82' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
81' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

77' The foul by Luis Diaz (Liverpool) was seen by Samuel Barrott who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
75' Arne Slot decides to make a substitution. Diogo Jota will be replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
74' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
74' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
72' James Garner (Everton) prepares to take a corner kick.
71' James Garner (Everton) sends the corner into the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher intercepts it and averts the threat. Everton have a corner.
69' Substitution. Jack Harrison makes his way off the pitch and Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) comes on as his replacement.
68' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
67' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. Liverpool will take a corner kick.
66' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
64' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
62' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Jordan Pickford comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' 74:26 – the ratio of ball possession.
57' 1 - 0 Goal! Luis Diaz slips a clever pass through to Diogo Jota (Liverpool), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
56' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
54' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
54' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.

53' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Jordan Pickford was alert and the score remained the same. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
52' Jack Harrison (Everton) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
51' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
50' Liverpool enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
48' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.

47' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
46' Referee Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+4' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post.
45+4' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. Everton will take a free kick.
45+3' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Jack Harrison (Everton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

37' James Garner (Everton) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
36' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
35' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dominik Szoboszlai, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
33' Beto (Everton) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
33' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
31' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Beto (Everton) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

28' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Jordan Pickford makes a comfortable save.
27' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
25' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
24' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
23' James Garner (Everton) commits a foul and Samuel Barrott immediately signals a free kick.
22' The goal by Everton is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
21' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Samuel Barrott is going to take a look using VAR.
20' A goal, which was scored by Beto (Everton), was disallowed due to offside.
19' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
19' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.
18' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
17' Jack Harrison (Everton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is behind the touchline and Everton will take a throw-in.

14' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
13' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
13' The ref seems satisfied following his VAR review and the yellow card for James Tarkowski (Everton) stands. Play continues.

12' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by James Tarkowski (Everton), but referee Samuel Barrott must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
12' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' James Tarkowski (Everton) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
11' Dangerous play by James Tarkowski (Everton). Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool have a free kick from a promising distance.
11' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Diogo Jota (Liverpool) inside the box.
8' Jordan Pickford displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
7' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Barrott no option but to blow his whistle.
5' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
2' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
